name: MiniMax H3 Highspeed
description: A multimodal video generation model that balances quality and speed, supporting text-to-video, first and last frame image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation at 768P.

examples.name: Product Commercial
examples.description: Studio-quality product ad from text at 768P, the kind of creative Highspeed turns around quickly.

content.text: Premium product commercial: a matte black wireless earbud case sits on a wet reflective surface, the lid opens on its own and soft rim light traces the edges [orbit]. Water droplets catch the light, then the camera settles on a clean centered hero shot [static].

examples.name: Sketch to Product Reveal
examples.description: Turn a design sketch into a photoreal product shot from a first frame.

content.text: The pencil sneaker sketch comes to life: graphite lines fill in with white leather, an orange suede heel panel and a translucent sole, and the sneaker lifts off the page onto a slowly rotating white studio turntable. Softbox lighting, crisp reflections, smooth camera orbit.

examples.name: Dusk to Milky Way
examples.description: End on a supplied last frame: a night-sky time-lapse.

content.text: Time-lapse over a quiet mountain landscape: the blue dusk sky darkens, the first stars appear and the Milky Way slowly rises into the final frame. Locked-off camera, gentle cloud movement.

examples.name: Mascot Comes to Life
examples.description: Controlled transition between a supplied first and last frame.

content.text: A flat illustrated robot mascot printed on a notebook page wakes up, blinks, peels itself off the paper into a glossy 3D toy, hops onto the wooden desk next to the coffee mug and waves at the camera. Warm morning light, playful stop-motion feel, one continuous shot.

examples.description: Keep a character consistent from a reference image in a new scene.

content.text: The robot mascot from the reference image rolls a pencil across the wooden desk, looks up at the camera and gives a thumbs-up. Keep the mascot's shape, colors and antenna exactly as in the reference. Warm morning light, shallow depth of field.
